_comment: HRA default hyperparameters. See ../MODEL_DESIGN.md §3 and §6, and ../HRA/analysis/diagnose_crash.py (the iter-888 NaN-crash post-mortem). Updated 2026-05-16 (post-mortem run): added cross_layer_via='input' to drop the cross-layer FT routing (which the cells learned to invert), plus stability fixes against runaway Q-distribution quantiles.

model._note_cross_layer: 'input': ascending cross-layer feedback is summed into the cell's z_t (simpler, more stable; the FT inside each cell does within-layer self-attention only). 'ft': original variant (ascending feedback routed via FT Q/K/V). Switch to 'ft' for theoretical-richness experiments; default to 'input' for the prototype because the iter-888 run's FT residual scales went *negative* in cells 1 and 3 (cells learned to invert FT output).
model._note_skips:
Bottom-up visual skip connections (V→C₂, V→C₃, C₁→C₃) ON. Biological motivation: retinotectal pathway (retina/V1 → superior colliculus, a deep midbrain structure that receives direct fast visual input), plus direct V1→V4 cortical bypass projections catalogued in Felleman & Van Essen 1991. Empirically with the new error-gated cells (update_gate_bias=0, surprise-amplified), the skips boost C₃ change-spike magnitude by 4.7× and C₂ by 2.2× over the chain-only setup, and do NOT over-drive any cell (steady-state magnitudes all ~0.3, vs the broken 13.85 seen with the previous gate dynamics).

NOTE: this only controls the bottom-up cell-input skips. The 'skips to actor and critic' (LayerHead per layer in DecisionReadout) are ALWAYS on — both actor and critic always see all three layer states.

training._note_lr: Down from 3e-4. PPO is sensitive to learning rate; the 3e-4 default contributed to the iter-888 instability where one bad batch produced a runaway gradient.
training._note_value_coef: Down from 0.5. With return magnitudes up to 5 and a distributional critic with 51 quantiles, value_coef=0.5 amplified Q residual gradient too aggressively. 0.25 keeps the critic supervised but quieter.
training._note_kappa: Down from 1.0. Caps per-quantile gradient magnitude at 0.5 (vs 1.0) outside the quadratic Huber region. The single most important stability knob for distributional RL with bounded rewards.
training._note_return_clip: Clip GAE return targets to [-5, +5]. The env's max single-frame reward is 5 (red press at change_time), so returns under γ=0.95 sit comfortably below 5. This is a defence against transient Q-bootstrap explosions that compound across PPO epochs.
training._note_kl_early_stop: Stop the PPO inner loop early if approx_kl > 0.02 after any epoch. Standard PPO trick (Schulman 2017 §6).
training._note_logit_clamp: Hard clamp on pre-softmax actor logits during the update. Prevents Categorical(NaN) crashes from extreme logits.

run._note_resume: If true and HRA/checkpoints/hra_latest.pt exists, load it before training. Matches PRISM v1's run-config pattern. Set to false to force a from-scratch run.
